mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This meal consists of kiwi fruit, which is low in calories and has a moderate glycemic impact, making it suitable for someone with diabetes. It is a nutrient-dense fruit rich in fiber and vitamins. It is best to include such whole fruits as part of a balanced diet to support stable blood sugar levels.
mealAnalysis.meal_description: Two halves of fresh kiwi fruit, providing natural sugars, fiber, and essential nutrients.
